hypothesis: Candidate-owned website text independently observed before a vote predicts that later vote.
inclusion: Literal archived candidate-owned website excerpt with original URL, full source SHA256, independently authenticated indexed digest and exact zoned observation timestamp
Fresh storage readback must match literal, stable legislator identity, source URL/SHA, observation, digest and every non-serving flag
Target is accepted official Senate floor passage event, with bill, session, explicit YEA or NAY and hearing-day member service bounds
Use first passage event per member/bill/session, chosen by event date then stable event key without reading vote side
exclusion: 526 source-metadata holds, 3 known-person out-of-study excerpts, conflicting source/clock, literal mismatch or duplicate ingestion rows
Unknown or unzoned observation clock; uncertain timestamp intervals whose latest possible instant is not before cutoff
Same target calendar day, unknown service boundary, committee/non-passage targets, other/absent labels
Retrospective source recovery, hand-labelled policy sincerity and outcome-driven text selection

clock.targetCutoff: 00:00:00 America/Chicago at start of target occurred_on; day-only target time is unknown
clock.comparison: latest possible authenticated observation instant strictly less than cutoff
clock.uncertainty: No imputed timezone or backdating; hold when latest bound is unknown
clock.party: Use target-session membership party only for explicitly bounded historical service; no current-party lookup.

joinsAndDuplicates.identity: Website membership -> stable legislator_id -> target membership/session with explicit service bounds; never district/surname join
joinsAndDuplicates.literalDuplicates: Same stable person plus exact UTF8 literal SHA256: retain earliest authenticated observation, break ties by source SHA then ingestion key; provenance copies retained separately
joinsAndDuplicates.overlappingExcerpts: Not assumed independent samples; no extra target rows per excerpt
joinsAndDuplicates.targetDuplicates: One member/bill/session target using first accepted passage event; repeated or reconsidered passages not independent outcomes
joinsAndDuplicates.textConstruction: All deduplicated qualifying literals, sorted by observation then SHA; deterministic 20000 Unicode-codepoint cap per person/target; vocabulary and IDF fit on training only

split.billGrouping: All members of a bill/session stay in the year of its first accepted Senate passage event, independent of vote side. Exclude cross-partition identical stored bill-version text hashes from primary; exclude missing bill hashes from primary. Report exclusions and temporal years without shifting splits.

baselines: Training-only overall YEA rate with Beta(1,1) smoothing
Training-only party-specific YEA rates with Beta(1,1) smoothing, unseen party falls back to overall
futureComparison.textModel: Separate non-serving logistic ridge delta using training-only word unigram/bigram TF-IDF plus baseline log odds; no external LLM or mutable encoder
futureComparison.selection: Lowest validation bill-macro log loss; tie chooses strongest regularization; no test tuning
futureComparison.uncertainty: 2000 seeded bill-cluster bootstrap replicates, seed 864; report paired deltas and 95% intervals; no causal claim

implementation.ridge: Minimize mean member-target logistic loss + lambda*||w||^2/2 with fixed party log-odds offset, no additional intercept; L-BFGS maxiter=1000, tolerance=1e-9
implementation.fitSampleWeight: Equal member-target weights, validation selection uses bill-macro loss
implementation.determinism: seed 864, one BLAS thread; no LLM or mutable embeddings
implementation.tie: validation losses within 1e-10 choose larger lambda

leakageChecks: Assert every source cutoff before target local midnight
Zero source or person joins by future office/district
No target vote text/results, post-cutoff source copy, future observation, outcome labels or post-vote source retrieval in feature inputs
Training-only vocabulary, IDF, smoothing and regularization selection
Preserve existing immutable evaluation freezes and production model weights; new isolated experiment outputs only
All available stored nonempty bill-version text hashes are used for cross-partition collision exclusion only, never as feature content; missing hashes excluded from primary and separately counted
Outcome-free roster/party, source and cohort census runs and is committed before the separate outcome-read workflow is enabled
Website-only model cannot certify bill-specific policy understanding; stable personal style/identity may explain a signal; exploratory interpretation required
coverageLimitations: 668 excerpts are not 668 independent votes or 668 people
Capture selection, old/prior-office pages, sparse senators and source survival create selection bias
Zero observed website excerpt does not mean no candidate position
Report candidate people, pages, text hashes, bills, member-bill targets, excluded counts and party/year coverage before outcomes

If any validation/test partition has fewer than 30 distinct target bills or 20 minority-class member-bill outcomes, label results exploratory and inconclusive; never move a split to manufacture sample size
Cohort preparation and storage verification demonstrate no predictive lift
executionPolicy: Owner authorized a separate isolated outcome experiment on 2026-10-19. This version must merge before any experiment outcomes are read. Freeze outcome-free cohort counts and commitments before enabling the separate outcome workflow. No production training, serving weights, forecasts, immutable freezes, floor processing or scheduler changes.
supersedesForNewExperimentOnly: v1 remains immutable; no outcomes were examined under v1
outputPolicy: Database rows, person IDs, vote sides, literal inputs and fitted weights remain in runner memory/private temporary files and are deleted. Publish aggregate metrics/coverage, seeded bill-cluster intervals, source/protocol/code/cohort commitments and workflow receipts only.
